difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 6.5.4 at source lines 678-682: for pointed types (A,a_0) and (B,b_0) the pointed mapping space Map_*(susp A, B) is equivalent to Map_*(A, Omega B). The author's proof (source lines 684-708) is a two-stage computation of equivalences, not a citation: the first chain at lines 686-692 rewrites susp A -> B by the suspension universal property, then reassociates a four-component sigma type three times, and the individual steps are justified afterwards at lines 693-697 by the suspension recursor, by associativity of sigma types and by the contractibility of the based path space. The second chain at lines 700-706 must re-expand with an extra pair (q, g(a_0) = q) before the same contractibility can be applied again, and only the final line is the definitional identification with Map_*(A, Omega B).
